messages:
maria: Heads-up 1: planning a micro social launch for Redwood Inference next Wed. Objective: drive dev sandbox signups + webinar RSVPs. Need final copy + GIF by Thursday EOD.

josh: Timeline ok. Recommend 2 X threads (bench + how-to) plus 1 LinkedIn longform. Stagger by region (NA/EU/APAC).

tara: CTA matrix: NA -> sandbox, EU -> case study, APAC -> webinar. Ill draft copy and two alt hooks for quick swap.

maria: Creative brief for @elliot: 3-frame GIF, include a tiny cost delta chart and "predictable latency" callout. Color: product blue + slate.

elliot: I can deliver GIF + 2 hero images by Thu afternoon if copy is locked by Wed noon. Need exact stat to call out.

josh: Proposed UTMs: utm_campaign=microlaunch-2837, utm_medium=social, utm_source={x|linkedin}, utm_content={na_thread|eu_thread|apac_linkedin}, cv=gifA. devon can map Zapier -> SDR queues.

tara: Draft is in Drive: https://drive.google.com/microlaunch-draft. I added alt hooks and a shortened data slide for X.

maria: Engagement plan: if <200 interactions in 24h, auto-boost top node ($400) and repost variant after 12h. ops-bot, please add alert for campaign id "microlaunch-2837".

ops-bot: Alert created for campaign "microlaunch-2837": threshold=200 interactions in 24h. Notifying @maria @josh @tara on trigger.

josh: Also reserve $300 for paid amplification earmarked for EU cohort if early signs are strong.

maria: Good call. Final checklist: copy (tara) Wed noon, assets (elliot) Thu EOD, UTMs & Zap (devon) Thu EOD, queue Fri morning. Ping with blockers. :rocket:
